name: The Stairwell: The Last Six Hours
read_aloud: Stairwell. Last six hours: free descent. Collapse follows the posted hour.
narrator_line: Stairwell. Last six hours: free descent.
layout: The plain concrete stairwell behind the stage, spiral steps down, an index card on the rail.

quick_run.setup: The stairwell behind the stage in the last six hours of the floor.
quick_run.decision: Descend now with the whole party, or wait for stragglers and risk the clock?
quick_run.on_success: Everyone who reaches a stairwell lives and the Floor Summary posts.
quick_run.on_failure: A Crawler still on the floor at the collapse is dead; the Reprieve does not apply.
quick_run.cut_short: Count heads, read the six-hours line, and run the descent in one beat.

loot.text: Stairwell Checkpoint, Floor Summary and descent procedure.
